purpose: Fresh independent evaluation after V3.1 method freeze
requirements: Do not reuse the frozen Phase-12 v1 cases as the final V3.1 test set.
Include natural k_prime=4 scenarios; do not resurrect rejected checklist-like v1 candidates.
Collect substantially more genuinely human-written scenarios than the 6/55 legacy benchmark.
Freeze the V3.1 selector before final labels/test outcomes are inspected.
Keep any generator-intent metadata inaccessible to annotators and selector code until evaluation is complete.
Use a new adversarial set that was not used to design V3.1.
